name: resolve_incident
description: Mark an incident Resolved with a close code and close notes. Requires approval. Use only when a KB article or a matching resolved incident names the fix and the requester has confirmed it; never resolve to clear a queue.

close_code.description: A close code the instance knows, for example 'Solved (Permanently)'.

close_notes.description: What fixed it, one to three sentences, written for the next analyst.
